reasoning: Virginia’s statewide Cook Partisan Voting Index is D+3. In the last 45 days, I found no credible state-specific general-election polling for Virginia’s 2026 Senate or presidential race; the available results were the Republican Senate primary, a race-status article noting Warner is effectively unchallenged, and forecast/market pages indicating the seat is overwhelmingly Democratic, so there is no current poll-based margin to report for the general election.
